```lean
constructor
· intro h_mono
  intros s a ha
  exact h_mono s (Finset.cons a s ha) (by simp [Finset.cons_eq_insert, Finset.mem_cons_iff])
· intro h_add
  intro s t h_subset
  let diff := t \ s
  cases diff with d hd
  · rw [diff_eq_empty]
    exact le_rfl
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hdiff⟩ := exists_mem_diff d hd
    have h1 : f s ≤ f (Finset.insert a s) := h_add s a ha
    have h2 : f (Finset.insert a s) ≤ f t :=
      by apply h_add _ _ _
        exact Finset.insert s a ha
        exact h_subset.trans (Finset.subset_insert a s)
    exact le_trans h1 h2
```
